name: nex_browser_list
description: Preferred NexBrowser OpenAPI tool for requests such as 'use NexBrowser to show or count my windows'. Lists managed NexBrowser environments/profiles. Never reports Chrome, Edge, the Codex in-app browser, operating-system application windows, or browser tabs.

groupId.description: Filter by window group from nex_browser_group_list; 0 lists ungrouped windows

name: nex_proxy_list
description: List proxy resources available in the active NexBrowser workspace so a proxyId can be selected for window creation or binding. Credentials are never returned.

state.description: Status filter; repeat as state=1&state=0. 0 unchecked, 1 ok, 2 deleted

name: nex_proxy_import
description: Import custom proxy resources from Desktop-compatible text lines the user supplied in the current request. Supported protocols are HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5. Credentials are never returned.

text.description: One proxy per line, copied from the current user request. Formats: protocol://user:pass@host:port {remark}, protocol://host:port:user:pass {remark}, user:pass@host:port, host:port:user:pass. Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5; omitted protocol defaults to SOCKS5. IPv6 hosts use [address]:port.

lines.description: Alternative to text: each entry is one Desktop-compatible proxy import line

name: nex_proxy_create
description: Create one custom proxy resource from protocol, host, and port, or pass items to create several. Prefer nex_proxy_import when the user pasted Desktop-compatible lines. Credentials are never returned.

protocol.description: SOCKS5, HTTP, or HTTPS; omitted create defaults to SOCKS5

host.description: Proxy host or IP; required unless items is set

protocol.description: SOCKS5, HTTP, or HTTPS; omitted create defaults to SOCKS5

items.description: Create several proxies in one call; each item needs host and port

name: nex_proxy_batch_create
description: Create multiple custom proxy resources from an items array. Each item needs host and port. Credentials are never returned.

protocol.description: SOCKS5, HTTP, or HTTPS; omitted create defaults to SOCKS5

items.description: Proxy objects; each item needs host and port. Also accepts proxies or proxyList

name: nex_proxy_modify
description: Update one existing custom proxy resource. Pass only the fields that must change. Credentials are never returned.

proxyId.description: Existing proxy resource ID from nex_proxy_list

protocol.description: SOCKS5, HTTP, or HTTPS; omitted create defaults to SOCKS5

name: nex_proxy_delete
description: Delete one or more custom proxy resources. Bought channel proxies may be rejected by Desktop. Credentials are never returned.

proxyId.description: One proxy ID or a list of proxy IDs to delete

name: nex_proxy_detect
description: Probe a proxy resource or an unsaved host:port for exit IP, location, and timezone. Credentials are never returned.

proxyId.description: Saved proxy ID to detect; omit when passing host and port

protocol.description: SOCKS5, HTTP, or HTTPS; omitted create defaults to SOCKS5

name: nex_browser_create
description: Create NexBrowser environments in the desktop app's active workspace. Every unset field falls back to the desktop create-window defaults (fingerprint, preferences, layout, startup page), and each created window gets its own generated fingerprint, so pass only the fields that must differ.

name.description: Window title; a batch of more than one appends -01, -02 to this name

groupId.description: Target window group; 0 keeps them ungrouped

proxyId.description: Proxy to bind; 0 means no proxy

accountIds.description: Platform account IDs to bind, so nex_browser_fill_account can sign in later

screen.description: Raw screen field overrides for the create payload

name: nex_browser_bind_proxy
description: Bind one proxy resource to one or more closed NexBrowser windows. Pass proxyId=0 to remove the binding. Running windows are rejected and must be closed first.

windowId.description: One window ID or a list of closed window IDs; alias of windowIds

proxyId.description: Proxy resource ID to bind; 0 removes the proxy binding

name: nex_browser_bind_account
description: Bind one or more workspace catalog platform accounts to one or more closed NexBrowser windows. This replaces the existing window binding. Pass accountIds=[] to remove it. Running windows are rejected and must be closed first. After opening, use nex_browser_accounts to fill.

windowId.description: One window ID or a list of closed window IDs; alias of windowIds

accountIds.description: Catalog account IDs that replace the window binding; [] or 0 removes all bound accounts

name: nex_browser_group_list
description: List the window groups of the active NexBrowser workspace with the window count of each, so a groupId can be selected for window creation, moving, or deletion. The first row is always the ungrouped bucket with groupId 0.

name: nex_browser_group_create
description: Create one window group in the active NexBrowser workspace. Group names must be unique inside the team; a duplicate name is rejected. Use nex_browser_group_modify to rename it, or nex_browser_move_to_group to put windows into the new group.

name.description: Group name; it must be unique inside the active team

seq.description: Sort order; defaults to the end of the list

name: nex_browser_group_modify
description: Rename or reorder one custom window group in the active NexBrowser workspace. Group names must stay unique inside the team. The ungrouped bucket (groupId 0) cannot be changed.

groupId.description: Custom group ID to rename or reorder; the ungrouped bucket 0 is rejected

name: nex_browser_group_delete
description: Delete one custom window group from the active NexBrowser workspace. The windows inside it are not deleted; they become ungrouped. The ungrouped bucket (groupId 0) cannot be deleted.

groupId.description: Custom group ID to delete; the ungrouped bucket 0 is rejected

name: nex_browser_move_to_group
description: Move one or more NexBrowser windows into a window group. Pass groupId=0 to move them out of any group. Groups are window metadata, so running windows can be moved without closing them first.

windowId.description: One window ID or a list of window IDs; alias of windowIds

groupId.description: Target group ID from nex_browser_group_list; 0 moves the windows out of any group

name: nex_browser_open
description: Start NexBrowser environments and return per-window status. For multi-window tasks, pass every window ID in one windowId array so Desktop can batch-start and tile them before creating automation sessions.

windowId.description: One window ID, or all target window IDs in one array for a single batch-start request.

name: nex_browser_connection_info
description: Inspect the status of running NexBrowser environments. Omit windowId to list every running window.

teamId.description: Optional team filter; OpenAPI uses the active team

windowId.description: One window ID or a list; omit to list every running window

name: nex_browser_close
description: Close one or more NexBrowser environments.

windowId.description: One window ID or a list; alias of ids

name: nex_browser_accounts
description: List autofill-capable credentials in the vault plugin of open NexBrowser environments, including bound platform accounts and user-saved passwords. Usernames are masked and secrets are never returned; call nex_browser_fill_account with an accountId from this result.

windowId.description: One window ID or a list

name: nex_account_list
description: List platform accounts in the workspace catalog so an accountId can be selected for window creation or later vault fill. This is not the open-window vault; use nex_browser_accounts after a window is running. Secrets are never returned.

name: nex_account_create
description: Create one platform account in the workspace catalog, or pass items to create several. Pass platformUrl; username, password, and 2FA secret are optional and write-only. This does not fill a login form.

platformUrl.description: Platform website URL, for example https://www.tiktok.com
Platform website URL, for example https://www.tiktok.com

items.description: Create several accounts in one call; each item needs platformUrl

name: nex_account_batch_create
description: Create multiple platform accounts from an items array. Each item needs platformUrl. Secrets are write-only and never returned.

platformUrl.description: Platform website URL, for example https://www.tiktok.com

items.description: Account objects; each item needs platformUrl. Also accepts accounts or accountList

name: nex_account_modify
description: Update one platform account in the workspace catalog. Pass only the fields that must change. Password and 2FA secret are write-only and never returned.

name: nex_account_delete
description: Delete one or more platform accounts from the workspace catalog. This does not close windows or remove vault copies already stored in an open window.

accountId.description: One account ID or a list of account IDs to delete

name: nex_browser_connect
description: Connect to one NexBrowser window using the active team by default and create an isolated automation session. For multiple windows, first call nex_browser_open once with all window IDs, then connect each window with startIfNeeded=false.

teamId.description: Optional team ID. Omit it to use the team currently selected in NexBrowser.

startIfNeeded.description: Explicitly start one window when it is not running. Keep false after a multi-window batch open.

name: nex_browser_disconnect
description: Disconnect an automation session without closing the NexBrowser environment.

name: nex_browser_fill_account
description: Ask the NexBrowser vault plugin to autofill the current login page with a stored credential. Call nex_browser_accounts first and pass only an accountId returned for this open window; the plugin chooses the visible fields and keeps passwords and 2FA secrets outside MCP. Call again after each navigation in a multi-step sign-in. This tool never submits the form.

sessionId.description: Optional session ID; defaults to this MCP client active session

pageId.description: Stable page ID; defaults to the session active page

accountId.description: Vault credential to use; optional when the open window has exactly one

name: nex_browser_fill_credentials
description: Fill literal login credentials that the user explicitly supplied in the current request into visible fields. Prefer nex_browser_fill_account when a stored vault credential is available, because literal values cross the model and MCP request boundary. Never store or repeat these values. This tool never submits the form.

sessionId.description: Optional session ID; defaults to this MCP client active session

pageId.description: Stable page ID; defaults to the session active page
